# Credits

RIFTFALL is built on open-source libraries and CC0 assets. Thank you to everyone involved.

## Assets

Downloaded on demand by `npm run assets` (`scripts/fetch-assets.mjs`) from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com)
into `public/assets/` – they are not committed to the repository. All Poly Haven assets are released under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (public domain); attribution is not required
but gladly given. The table below is regenerated from `src/defs/assets.ts` whenever the script runs.

<!-- ASSET-CREDITS:BEGIN (generated by scripts/fetch-assets.mjs) -->

| Asset id          | Asset                   | Author(s)                      | Source                                          | License |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `hdri.industrial` | Empty Warehouse 01      | Sergej Majboroda               | https://polyhaven.com/a/empty_warehouse_01      | CC0     |
| `tex.floor`       | Metal Plate             | Rob Tuytel                     | https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_plate             | CC0     |
| `tex.concrete`    | Concrete Floor Worn 001 | Dimitrios Savva, Rico Cilliers | https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_floor_worn_001 | CC0     |

<!-- ASSET-CREDITS:END -->

Without downloaded assets the game uses GPU-generated procedural textures and a procedural environment.

### Audio

All sound effects in this milestone are synthesized procedurally at runtime (`src/audio/synth.ts`,
Web Audio `OfflineAudioContext`) – no third-party samples are used.

## Libraries

| Library                                                                                              | Version | License                                             | Use                                              |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js)                                                       | 0.186   | MIT                                                 | Rendering, loaders (glTF, HDR, KTX2, Draco), CSM |
| [postprocessing](https://github.com/pmndrs/postprocessing)                                           | 6.39    | Zlib                                                | Post-processing pipeline                         |
| [n8ao](https://github.com/N8python/n8ao)                                                             | 2.0     | CC0 1.0 (LICENSE file; `package.json` declares ISC) | Screen-space ambient occlusion                   |
| [Rapier](https://github.com/dimforge/rapier.js) (`@dimforge/rapier3d-compat`)                        | 0.20    | Apache-2.0                                          | Physics, character controller                    |
| [three-mesh-bvh](https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh)                                        | 0.9     | MIT                                                 | Accelerated raycasts                             |
| [Preact](https://github.com/preactjs/preact)                                                         | 10.29   | MIT                                                 | Menus / UI                                       |
| [meshoptimizer](https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer) decoder (via three.js)                        | 1.1     | MIT                                                 | Meshopt-compressed glTF                          |
| [Draco](https://github.com/google/draco) decoder (bundled from three.js)                             | –       | Apache-2.0                                          | Draco-compressed glTF                            |
| [Basis Universal](https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal) transcoder (bundled from three.js) | –       | Apache-2.0                                          | KTX2 textures                                    |

Development tooling (Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, ESLint, Prettier, fake-indexeddb, jsdom, Playwright) is not
shipped with the game; see `package.json` for their licenses.
